title: Build the trim result from a finished job
heading: No Plan Means null, Never Infinity
cases: an optimal job's result lists its circuits sorted, its hours per month against capacity, and a zero gap
a month with capacity but no chosen work still has a row, with 0 hours
the month rows are in increasing month order whatever the order of the capacity dict
the gap divides the distance to the bound by the plan's value, not by the bound
an infinite bound with no plan becomes null, with no gap, and the JSON reads back into an equal result
a plan worth 0 with a bound of 3 has a gap of 3, not a division by zero
a bound a hair below the value gives a gap of 0, not a negative gap the schema refuses
